speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The latch. And do not take a stool out with thee. Looking is not sitting with the furniture moved.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have no stool in my hand. I know the difference. Thou looked, and thou didst not touch it. I can do as much.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: If thou art going, go. I can hear thee being obedient in the passage, and the passage has work in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am through. Call me when the loaf is a loaf. I will not come in for a speech.
